copy.heading: Why are we going there?

items: The family have always wanted to go.
There is a beach and a kids' club.
It is near a course that "has had some really good reviews".
The villa is "only twenty minutes from three championship courses".
Keith went last year and got a hole in one.

blocks.text: If you ticked any of the last three, you have not understood the question.

copy.instructions: Look at the reasons below. Tick the ones that are acceptable reasons for choosing a family holiday.
